g.title: NTM_MAC_QSP_Model
g.text: Nontuberculous Mycobacterial Lung Disease (MAC-PD) — QSP Mechanistic Map
Four physically separate bacterial niches × four drug-delivery routes: why the drug that reaches the phagosome is inactivated there,
and why inhaled liposomal amikacin is the only agent that crosses barrier 1 and barrier 3 at the same time
